pages.title: Tundra Games
text: Jessie has developed an innovative new training method for Sergey, who dreams of becoming a boxing champion – an extremely challenging punching bag trial! The Tundra Games take place irregularly. During the event, characters such as brawlers, snowmen, or pumpkins must be defeated. It consists of several mini-missions and games that offer rewards. The event is divided into seven parts: Camp Frostpunch, Whirlwind Wallop, Kitty Rescue, King of Treasure, Snowcapped Symphony, Top-up Benefits, and Supply Station.
Camp Frostpunch is the most rewarding part of the Tundra Games. In this event, players use Energized Bread to repeatedly punch Brawler Buddies for rewards.
Every time you defeat a Brawler Buddy, you get a chance to trigger a battle with the Arctic Crusher —a super-sized brawler that offers the best prizes in the event.

The more hits you land on the Crusher, the better your odds of earning high-tier rewards. Each punch you land—whether on a regular Brawler Buddy or on the Crusher—also gives you 2 Frostpunch Points , which contribute to event progress and milestones.
Tip 1: Make sure to get 300 Frostpunch Points daily to unlock the Daily Chest Rewards.
Tip 2: For a higher chance of getting the Best Boxer’s Bounty, and getting some free bread, you want to be hitting the Brawler Buddies when the treasure points are relatively high. Over 12,000 .

Note: At the end of the Tundra Games, any remaining Energized Bread in your inventory are automatically converted into 1,000-resource supply chests , so it’s beneficial to use as many as you can before the event ends.

Whirlwind Wallop is the milestone reward track of the Tundra Games. By participating in Camp Frostpunch , you earn Frostpunch Points , which increase your level on the Whirlwind Wallop progress bar and unlock rewards along the way.
The reward track is divided into tiers.
The more Frostpunch Points you earn, the more milestones and rewards you can claim across all unlocked tiers.
Kitty Rescue is a reflex-based mini-game featuring the mythic hero Reina . Your goal is to rescue the kitten by breaking a spinning ice block using thrown kunai.

Tap anywhere on the screen to throw kunai downward. Within the limited time available, every kunai must hit the rotating ice block to successfully rescue the kitty. Timing and precision are key, as the ice block constantly spins.
Each cleared stage will provide you with various rewards, including energised bread.
Note : Be careful not to hit any kunai that are already stuck in the ice block—doing so will immediately fail the attempt.
This event is divided into seven stages , each lasting one day :
During each stage, players earn points by completing the specific tasks assigned to that stage. As you accumulate points, you can claim milestone rewards once the required thresholds are reached.

At the end of every stage, Stage Ranking Rewards are distributed based on each player’s ranking for that day. Once all seven stages are complete, Total Ranking Rewards are awarded based on overall performance across the entire event.
Snowcapped Symphony is a mission-based event where players complete a set of designated tasks to earn rewards.
Notes: Any rewards that are not claimed before the event ends will be sent by in-game mail automatically.

To unlock the rewards in the Top-Up Benefits , players must purchase Gems during the event. Each Gem purchase contributes progress toward the Top-Up milestones, and additional rewards are unlocked as the required thresholds are reached.
The Supply Station shows all the ways players can obtain Energised Bread during the Tundra Games. Energised Bread is a key event resource, as it is required to land punches in Camp Frostpunch .

pages.title: Wild Brawl
text: 1️⃣ Introduction Wild Brawl is a recurring event that lasts 2 days once the State has reached the required age.

In each match, 10 Chiefs face each other in a free-for-all fight. On the battlefield, Chiefs can earn points by occupying buildings and gathering strategic supplies, while picking up and using airdropped items will also provide a massive advantage. The Chief with the highest score at the end of the match will claim victory!

Chiefs with a Furnace Lv.25 or higher can participate in matchmaking. – The event is not available before Hero Generation 3. – Each Chief can participate in 10 matches per event period. This is the total for the 2-day event, not a daily allowance. – A match attempt is consumed once matchmaking succeeds and you enter the battlefield. Once your number of matches reaches zero, matchmaking will no longer be available.
Each day, 4 matchmaking periods are available, each lasting 2 hours . Matchmaking is only possible during these time windows.
There are two matchmaking modes :
Same-Gen Battle : Only Chiefs at the same Hero Generation will be matched together.
Cross-Gen Battle : Chiefs from all States will be matched regardless of Hero Generation.
After selecting a matchmaking mode, Chiefs enter the corresponding lobby.
Once 10 Chiefs are present and ready , the Wild Brawl battlefield for that room becomes available.
To enter Wild Brawl, you must not have troops currently scouting or on expedition, burning barricades or reinforcements from other Chiefs in your Embassy.
You will use your own troops on the battlefield, and the number of march queues available is determined by the number of march queues you have unlocked so far.

The Infirmary capacity is considered unlimited during the battle. Healing troops does not consume resources, and they can only be healed using the Battlefield MedKit. When you leave the battlefield, your troops will be automatically healed.
After attacking another Chief and winning the battle, you will not be able to loot their resources.
Cities burn much faster on the battlefield. If a City’s defense fails and the fire is not extinguished quickly, the city will be forcefully relocated to a random location.

Bonuses related to President/Supreme President titles, President skills, Frost Dragon Tyrant titles, and Territory bonuses are all disabled on the battlefield. However, 10% / 20% buffs and battle-related pet bonuses still function normally; Pet Gathering Skills do not apply.
Note: You can return to your City temporarily, but if you choose to quit the event completely, you will not be able to re-enter that event session. Check the confirmation prompt before leaving.
Battlefield matches last 10 minutes . The first 30 seconds are the Preparation Phase. The next 9 minutes 30 seconds are the Battle Phase.
There are 4 buildings to capture once the battle begins. A Chief who occupies a building for 10 seconds gains control of it and begins earning Strategic Points every second from that building.

After 30 seconds into the Battle Phase , 3 supply trucks enter the battlefield every minute. When they reach the three circular areas , they’ll unload strategic supply crates . Send troops to collect them and gain additional Strategic Points.
After 1 minute and 30 seconds into the Combat Phase , item crates will be airdropped in the center of the map every 2 minutes. To collect them, the game gives you a special walk.
Note : You can only collect one item at a time. You’ll have to wait for your walk to return before sending another one. What you can get is random.
On the interface, on the right, you’ll see a Battle Record tab. It lets you review your most recent matches , your final ranking , and the rankings of the other participants in each match.
If you click on the arrow on the right and the small “!” icon , you can also view your total points.
These are calculated in three ways : building points (earned by occupying buildings), gathering points (once trucks drop supply crates), and airdrop points (earned by using a random item)
As mentioned earlier, there are 4 special items that can be obtained through airdrops.
Each item has unique effects , and when used at the right time, they can change the outcome of the battle .

Among the four buildings, there is a Twilight Citadel located in the center of the map, as well as three Boulder Fortress. Each building awards points for initial capture and then for continuous control ( after 10 seconds ). The Citadel, however, is the building that awards the most points. But keep in mind that it is often the one most sought after by players.
During the 2 days of the event , 10 missions can be completed. You can complete them across both days; they do not all need to be finished in one day.
The match-participation reward missions go up to 6 matches, but Chiefs can participate in up to 10 matches per event.

headings: Additional tips for setting up for the bear trap
text: After the goal of kindling embers is achieved, alliances can build the hunting trap to hunt the raging bear.
The hunting event can be activated by R4/R5 every two days. And once the event is opened, all the members will only have 30 minutes to defeat the raging bear.
An alliance can summon the bear every 47.5 hrs.
The cooldown for the Bear Trap means you can participate again at the start of the second calendar day after your participation day, according to server time (UTC).
Day of Participation: (e.g., Monday, anytime you play).

First Day After Participation (First “Reset Day”): The entire next calendar day (e.g., all of Tuesday, from 00:00 UTC to 23:59 UTC). This is when the first server reset occurs after your participation.
Second Day After Participation (Second “Reset Day”): As soon as this day begins (e.g., Wednesday at 00:00 UTC), you can participate again.

Very simply: If you participate in the Bear Trap on Monday (anytime), you wait for all of Tuesday to pass, and then as soon as Wednesday starts (at 00:00 UTC), you can participate again. The countdown starts immediately when you attack, and the idea is you can participate once the server has “reset” twice since your last participation.
Your rewards will get better the more damage your troops are able to do to it.
You can get arrowheads from looting beasts around the map which can be used to upgrade the damage dealt to the bear by 25% (max lvl5).
Note: Only lvl5 + alliance can build the event building.

pages.title: SVS – State Of Power
text: There are FOUR phases : Matchmaking Phase Preparation Phase Battle Phase Field Triage Phase 1. MATCHMAKING PHASE States having similar or very close power levels are paired together. This phase lasts over two days (Saturday and Sunday). Day 1 : The system assesses your state’s power and seeks out another state that closely matches it in terms of power. Matchmaking Points are calculated based on the Troop Power of the top 100 chiefs within each state, as well as considering factors such as state battle records and overall activeness. Day 2 : You find out which state your team will be facing off against in the State vs State (SVS) event. During this stage, you’ll have the opportunity to examine your opponent’s information and prepare accordingly. 2. PREPARATION PHASE This phase lasts six days . For the first five days, both states earn points by completing tasks — similar to events like King of Icefield .
1. My Points & Alliance Points Every task you complete adds its full point value directly to your personal score and your alliance’s score.

2. State Points Your completed tasks also contribute points to your whole state — but the amount depends on your Furnace level . Higher level = more contribution:(Level requirements may be adjusted based on State progression)
At the end of the phase, the state with higher total points earns a State Bonus and the battle takes place in the losing state’s territory.

headings: Tips, Tricks and Other Helpful Information
text: Dreamscape Memory is a recurring event mini game that plays like a scavenger hunt. This mini game debuted during the 3rd Anniversary Event and is a recurring event.
Rewards come in three forms: Daily Missions , Chapter Rewards and Recall Road .
Daily Missions are easy rewards to achieve by simply logging in, finding items and (if you can afford to spend) making any purchase 1 time(s).
Chapter Rewards are collected after the completion of all sections within the chapter.

Recall Road is a slow grind reward system. When you complete a section, you collect Recall XP that can be claimed upon completion of chapters. This XP adds to your Recall Road and will allow you to collect rewards the more you play Dreamscape Memory.

The most notable prizes in Recall Road are the Cloud Fantasy city skin , Ninja Meow march skin , Dream Odyssey avatar frame skin , and copy of the Dream Nest event island building . Be aware that this event island building can NOT be upgraded with island mythic general shards, only with its own pieces earned from this event. Like many events, there are both passes and packs available for purchase. There is a $5 and $10 pass available, that contain regular items (including gems, general speed ups, lucky hero gear chests, and essence stones) and the more valuable Dream Fishtins (that will allow you to play more chapters of this event) and bonus Recall XP to progress in the Recall Road prizes.

text: Phaethon Mercenaries have seized control of a nearby mining region and pressed the locals into slavery. Gina’s Eagles have accepted a contract to remove them, but she’s worried they may be overmatched.
So Gina’s put out word her company would be willing to share the Prestige and Bounty for helping to take down Phaethon…
This event is split into two elements : Personal Challenges , and Alliance Challenges .

When the event begins, select a difficulty tier (Champions, Epic, Legends, or Fearless) and a difficulty level within that tier (Easy, Normal, Hard, Nightmare, or Insane) . Difficulties above Easy must be earned by clearing the previous level in a prior event — at minimum, you’ll need to complete this event 20 times to unlock all difficulty levels.

Once selected, all challenge waves will be locked to that tier and level for the duration of the event. To begin, scout a Phaethon Mercenary from the Event tab by clicking ‘ Scout ‘ (costs 15 stamina). This will locate one on the world map, giving you 1 hour to defeat it. You can tackle it in one of three ways:
Total Stamina Cost (25 Mercenaries)
⚠️ Note: If you don’t defeat the target within the hour, you’ll need to spend stamina again to re-scout it.

1: The battle is divided into three stages. In Stage 1, you need to occupy as many neutral buildings as possible and seize control of enemy buildings. The points gained from occupying buildings will determine the winner.

4: A competent tactician understands the importance of using fuel wisely. It costs fuel to move, conscript, advance, retreat, and revive your troops on the battlefield. 5: Different types of defenders of varying sizes are garrisoned at different buildings. The defenders will not leave their buildings. Instead, they will revive some time after they are defeated. 6: The battle sequence within a building is determined by the order in which the squads arrive. At the end of each battle, the winning squad will be moved to the end of the queue, whereas the defeated squad will be eliminated and can be revived at the Bastion.
7: If a friendly squad is engaging in a battle in a building with a total of 5 squads queueing for attack or defend, you can spend Gems to use Battle Speedups to reduce the battle time.

8: When there are 5 squads on the queue, you can use fuel to make your squad advance and attack nearby enemy buildings, provided that the building is adjacent to friendly buildings. If you choose to retreat, the squad will retreat to an adjacent friendly building with some losses.

text: Summary Introduction Alliance Individual Tips Calculator Contributor Introduction In this event, in order to obtain points, you must send reinforcements to your alliance partners and they will do the same to you. A camp will be created by the system from which soldiers will be sent to attack your city. This is an event that takes place in waves. There are 3 levels where if you are online during those levels, you will get more points . This also applies to your friends; if they are online, you will get more points. The event lasts about 40 mins . Before the event, send your troops to defend your friends’ towns. There will be 21 difficulty levels in Crazy Joe. The event takes place on Tuesday and Thursday during the SvS/KOI/HoC week . Rewards are sent the next day at 12 UTC , so on Wednesday and Friday . You can do as many Joe events as you want , but only one per alliance , and the best score is kept . The total alliance score is only the points made by players in their alliance during the event . Rewards improve over server age . You will receive alliance rewards in the alliance you are in at 10 UTC the next day , but your best individual score is kept. If you score 2 million solo points but don’t have alliance points, and then join an alliance that, for example, scored 60 million but you only contributed 500k in that alliance, you will receive the missing milestone rewards because your highest solo score is kept. Teleporting during the event cancels the part of the event you’re in, whether it’s wave 1 to 9 or 11 to 18. If you lose two defenses on a city you will no longer be able to get points from that city . The same thing also works for your city ; if you lose two defenses, you will no longer be able to get points from it. Alliance • In Crazy Joe, there are 21 levels of difficulty . • There will be two waves where you will have to send your troops to the headquarters , and they are wave 10 and wave 20 . • During the event, try to be online and send troops to people who are also online so that you can get higher scores and earn great rewards.

Use all marches that you can and send soldiers to your friends who are online. If possible, I recommend that you get a farm account so that you have a secure online account with which to score more points.

When you send troops, send only infantry first, and when it is depleted, send Lancers. Infantry, in the Crazy Joe event, get the most kills, while Marksmen don’t contribute to kills except in a few very specific cases.

At the end of waves 9 and 19, recall your march with better heroes and send it to the HQ. I recommend sending 90% Infantry and 10% Lancers, as in some situations, even the Lancers will make kills inside the HQ. If there are few Lancers in the headquarters, yours will be the ones to make the most kills.
When you send your marches to your friends, make sure they have few reinforcements, because otherwise, you will score fewer points since your troops will not be the only ones defending their city.
You will notice that there will be some troop injuries as the waves progress. Do not heal them; otherwise, they will remain inside your city and take kills away from those who reinforce you.

Ensure that when you send troops to reinforce your friends, they have also sent away all their troops like you, so they can’t steal kills from you. If they have Marksmen inside, don’t worry, as they won’t get kills.
If possible, activate all pets and buffs, as they will help you get more kills and allow you to send more troops due to increased army capacity.

Members of a legion do not need to be from the same alliance , they can be anyone from the server. So states can work together in a state alliance or help a specific alliance to win the tournament.

This is an elimination style tournament, so as long as your legion keeps winning you keep playing but once you lose your legion is out. If your legion makes it beyond Thursday at 23:59 UTC, you will not be able to play the regular foundry event for that week .

Similar to Frost Dragon Tyrant, there are daily tasks in which all players can earn two kinds of tickets which can be used to bet on matches in both rounds. Match stakes (purple tickets) are used to bet on all matches in every round and champion stakes (gold tickets) are used to bet on which legion you think will become champion of the zone for that season.
These match and champion stakes can be used in the ordinary shop and champion shop , respectively.

The most notable items within these shops are the ever elusive mithril in the ordinary shops and the teleport skin and non-champion event island building in the champion shop. Please note that TAL island buildings cannot be upgraded with island general shards. You need to collect the actual pieces to level them.

Rewards from TAL come in many forms. There are the leaderboard rewards for both legion and alliance ranking, and individual combat participation rewards. Alliance ranking and individual combat participation rewards are comprised of match and champion stakes, arsenal (foundry) coins, mythic hero general shards and speedups of varying amounts dependent on one’s ranking.

The legion ranking rewards include 30 day march skins, island buildings, champion stakes, arsenal (foundry) coins, mithril, fire crystal, mythic hero general shards. Please note the march skins and island buildings are only for the top four legions and furthermore , the first place legion’s march differs from second, third and fourth place’s march AND the first place legion gets an additional island building.

Additionally, the top four alliances in each zone (i.e. the winners of each group within a zone) earns several alliance rewards including: a new alliance banner that is purple, a crossed cannons logo, and a the TAL alliance statue.
For the winning alliance in a zone, they get even more alliance rewards: a second alliance banner that is orange, a tank logo, their TAL alliance statue gets upgraded, and an alliance HQ skin.

There are two sets of packs that are available during this event: the Tundra Arms Pack found on the packs page and the Tundra Hero Pack found on the TAL event page. The Tundra Arms Packs features gems, teleports, march speeds, march recalls, assorted 20% buffs, and healing speeds. Whereas the Tundra Hero Pack gives players the ability to purchase Custom Mythic Hero Shard Chests for their current generation of heroes.

pages.title: Tundra Trade Route
text: Tundra Trade Routes is a PvP event involving raiding enemy trade carts and runs for 6 days (day 7 until 4utc can collect loot from day 6 ), this event occurs together with Alliance showdown but can occur for some states by itself without Alliance showdown event. The only overlap of these events is earning extra tickets to refresh your personal carts to get a higher tier cart for more rewards and earning some additional points towards daily tasks for Alliance showdown. (gems can be used to refresh trucks if you don’t have any more tickets).

The Primary Rewards for Tundra Trade routes is various resources such as: Mythic shards, essence stones, alloy, polish, charms, gear XP, scrolls, pet food, normal resources and additional alliance showdown points. These resources will be randomly assigned to Trucks that according to rarity with SSR having the best resources.

Each day you can send off your own trucks 4x for rewards and raid other players 4x. -For your own trucks, you will have up to 2 at a time to send off ranging in rarity from Normal, Common, Rare, SSR. You can use Tickets (earned from Alliance showdown chests) or gems (at increasing costs) to refresh these trucks to try get better loot. After 6 refreshes you will guaranteed to get a SSR Truck. -The trucks travel time takes approximately 3.5hrs and can be collected the next day. Daily reset for your own trucks is based on when they are sent, so you if you collect the next day, will not take up an attempt for the 2nd day. -You will assign troops to guard each truck and defend you against any attackers, if you get successfully raided, then a portion of the rewards will go to the attacker with a maximum of losing up to 50% of the total rewards. -You can also request help from your alliance members to help guard your truck, but can only request help once/day. -Any changes in states including gem buffs will happen in real time, so if you change gear, upgrade heroes or activate pets, the states of your troops guarding the truck will reflect any changes made. -Trucks that are not sent will roll over to the next day
Rewards from each truck is randomly assigned and successful raids will also deduct random items from the list of available loot (shown as “X” for items raided from your Truck)

Raiding other players -You can raid other players 4x a day, failed attempts wont be counted and there are no penalties other than a 10min cooldown from attacking the same player. You can also attack the same player twice in a row for loot (there is a limit of 2 successful raids on any single player, after which that player cant be attacked again) -You can refresh your targets for free, aim to target the SSR Trucks that have items you need, but which items you actually obtain from the list is random.
-You can also find Trucks roaming around in the world map, these can be shared via DM or alliance chat and raided.

You can help your allies by lending them your strongest troops to guard their trucks (you can still use these heroes for your own Trucks or normal game play at the same time) -Will get a small amount of rewards depending depending on how successful you are on guarding the trucks. -Can only guard allies truck 1 at a time, but can guard up to 3 trucks a day for rewards.
Refreshing your own trucks costs truck tickets earned from Alliance Showdown event.
6th Refresh onwards will guarantee Mythic Truck If you run out of tickets, can use gems instead 1st refresh 100gems 2nd refresh 200gems 3rd refresh 300gems 4th refresh 400gems 5/6th refresh 500gems

On the raid interface, what all the different symbols mean. 1) Having 1 fire on the truck means this cart has already been raided 1x (can be looted 1x more still) 2) Having 2 fires means this truck has been raided 2x (can’t be attacked anymore) 3) The red person with the attack crossed swords symbol means this person has attacked one of your trucks recently (either your truck or ally’s one you are protecting) 4) If the truck is labelled with letters, this means that this truck belongs to the current alliance you are fighting against in alliance showdown (its best to attack these if possible as this will decrease the alliance showdown points gained if your attack is successful).
Note: the trucks are color coded for rarity (N-gray, R-blue, SR-purple, SSR-orange)
